Q5460.reason: A painter’s blame of coworkers for failing to reinforce a wall is outside the scope of his painting job, so it is not an employer vicarious admission and the hearsay objection is sustained.

Q8222.reason: OKT3 induction plus fever, fatigue, and cold symptoms six weeks after a kidney transplant in a young recipient point to EBV, in addition to suspected rejection from the rising creatinine.

Q5849.reason: Testimony that computer records were kept on a regular business basis does not satisfy the full business-records or authentication foundation, so the court will require more proof of reliability.
